column1: The Grand Titan T-IT-N10X is a pre-production prototype, armed with two one-shot Streak SRM 2 launchers as last-ditch weapons. The 'Mech first had them mounted high on the shoulders, but targeting problems pushed VEST to move them to the wrists. It eventually lost them entirely in favor of more heat sinks and missile reloads in the production -N10M variant. The T-IT-N10X was first tested on Solaris, where it appeared in promotional materials after a famous win over an Atlas in a Class 4 arena. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 大泰坦 T-IT-N10X 是一款预生产原型机，装备两具一次性连发 SRM 2 发射器作为最后手段武器。该机甲最初将它们安装在肩部高位，但瞄准问题促使 VEST 将其移至手腕。最终，生产型 -N10M 为换取更多散热器和导弹补充弹药而完全取消了这些武器。T-IT-N10X 首次在 Solaris 上进行测试；它在 4 级竞技场击败 Atlas 后，出现在宣传材料中。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Grand Titan T-IT-N10Y was Vining's attempt to combine the best of the -N10X prototype with more modern technology. It carries an experimental XXL engine and restores the one-shot weapons that the -N10X dropped, while also using a standard internal structure as a "cost-saving measure". However, the T-IT-N10Y's high price tag still scared off most potential buyers and is a rare sight as a result. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 大泰坦 T-IT-N10Y 是 Vining 试图将 -N10X 原型机的优点与更现代技术结合起来的产物。它搭载实验性 XXL 引擎，并恢复了 -N10X 放弃的一次性武器，同时采用标准内骨架作为“节约成本的措施”。然而，T-IT-N10Y 的高昂价格仍令大多数潜在买家望而却步，因此十分罕见。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Grand Titan T-IT-N18M was created when the satellite factory producing the standard 400 XL engines suffered a suspected bio-weapon release. As a result the variant swaps in a 300 standard fusion engine with MASC and a Supercharger, pushing its speed well past the norm. It was also refitted for extreme-range combat, carrying an Extended LRM 15 and ER lasers. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 大泰坦 T-IT-N18M 诞生于生产标准 400 XL 引擎的卫星工厂疑似发生生化武器泄漏之后。因此，该变体换装了配备 MASC 和增压器的 300 标准聚变引擎，使速度远超常规。它还针对超远程作战进行了改装，搭载一具增程 LRM 15 和多门增程激光器。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Grand Titan T-IT-N18S was an attempt to bring the Regulan -N14R "Vengeance" variant, a very specialized and morally questionable 'Mech, into mainstream use. It keeps the lasers but replaces the Thumper artillery piece and its "alleged" nuclear payload with an Improved Heavy Gauss rifle. It also reverts to standard armor and the original 400 XL engine, while borrowing the -N18M's speed enhancements, which gives it surprising maneuverability. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 大泰坦 T-IT-N18S 试图将 Regulan 的 -N14R“复仇”变体（一种高度专业且在道德上颇有争议的机甲）投入主流使用。它保留激光武器，但将 Thumper 火炮及其“据称”的核载荷替换为改进型重型高斯步枪。它还恢复了标准装甲和原始的 400 XL 引擎，并借用 -N18M 的速度强化，因此拥有出人意料的机动性。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: The Grand Titan T-IT-N20C is a major refit performed at Calloway VI that replaces virtually everything except the bones with Clan equivalents. As a result it mounts two capacitor-enhanced Snub-Nose PPCs for a powerful knockout punch at close range, and its Supercharger helps it get there. The 'Mech's pilots also value the slight range advantage of the Clan weapons, using it to lure in enemies expecting the performance of the standard T-IT-N10M. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 大泰坦 T-IT-N20C 是在 Calloway VI 进行的一次重大改装，除骨架外几乎全部替换为氏族等效部件。因此，它安装了两门电容增强短管 PPC，能在近距离造成强力一击；增压器则帮助它迅速接近目标。该机甲的驾驶员也看重氏族武器略有优势的射程，并利用这一点诱使敌人接近，因为敌人会预期它具备标准 T-IT-N10M 的性能。 特性：多目标追踪 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: As a drone the Lich is vulnerable to electronic warfare systems. To prevent problems an Angel ECM suite is installed in the head. Room for this system was found by using a small cockpit. The two side torsos each mount a single light Gauss rifle and a Clan-spec ER large laser. These weapons have similar firing ranges, and can hit targets at an impressive range. The Light Gauss Rifles only have a single ton of ammunition each, however, which can limit their usefulness. Protecting against Gauss rifle explosions are two torso-mounted CASE II systems. To allow the Lich to stay in the fight even after sustaining damage, Clan-built Harjel II repair systems are installed in the three torso locations. These systems effectively "regenerate" small amounts of armor damage. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16
column2: 作为无人机，巫妖容易受到电子战系统影响。为避免问题，头部安装了一套天使 ECM 套件。通过使用小型驾驶舱，为该系统腾出了空间。两侧躯干各装有一门轻型高斯步枪和一门氏族规格的增程大型激光器。这些武器射程相近，能够在很远的距离上命中目标。不过，每门轻型高斯步枪只有一吨弹药，这会限制其效用。两套安装在躯干上的 CASE II 系统用于防护高斯步枪爆炸。为使巫妖即使受损也能继续作战，三个躯干位置均安装了氏族制造的 Harjel II 修复系统，能够“再生”少量装甲损伤。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.16

column1: An experimental version of the Lich that incorporates an actual MechWarrior piloting it instead of remote controlling. Since the head is too small to fit a human, a torso mounted cockpit is needed. The freed weight capacity from removing the heavy remote drone control system is used to upgrade the engine, increase the armor and adding an extra Large Laser, but at the cost of downgrading to HarJel I instead HarJel II. Quirk: Modular Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 巫妖的实验型版本搭载真正的机甲驾驶员，而非远程控制。由于头部过小，无法容纳人类，因此需要安装躯干驾驶舱。拆除沉重的无人机远程控制系统后释放的重量容量，用于升级引擎、增加装甲并加装一门大型激光器，但代价是将 HarJel II 降级为 HarJel I。 特性：模块化武器 投放费用倍率：1.18

column1: Designed by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team, the Grand Titan was conceived to take on and defeat any opponent. Built around a 400-rated XL Engine and an Endo Steel chassis, the Grand Titan has 18 tons of armor. The Grand Titan carries a large arsenal of weapons that allow it to work best at short to medium range. The longest-range weapon carried is an Artemis IV enhanced LRM-15 with 2 SRM-6's for closer range engagements.   Two Large Pulse Lasers, two Medium Pulse Lasers and two Small Pulse Lasers provide additional mid to short range firepower.  An AMS system provides a degree of protection from missiles.
column2: Grand Titan 由 Vining Engineering and Salvage Team 设计，旨在迎战并击败任何对手。它以 400 额定 XL 引擎和内骨架底盘为核心，拥有 18 吨装甲。Grand Titan 搭载了大量武器，最适合在近至中距离作战。其最远射程武器是一具配备阿尔忒弥斯 IV 的 LRM-15，另有两具 SRM-6 用于近距离交战。两门大型脉冲激光、两门中型脉冲激光和两门小型脉冲激光提供额外的中近程火力，AMS 系统则提供一定程度的反导防护。

column1: The Lich drone assault 'Mech was designed by the Word of Blake but was only fielded in limited numbers during the defense against Operation SCOUR. An altered version was later used by the RAF after the Republic of the Sphere enacted their Fortress Protocols. The endo-composite skeleton is protected by seventeen tons of standard armor, allowing the Lich to remain in a fight after taking a massive amount of damage.
column2: 巫妖无人机突击机甲由布雷克之言设计，但在抵御 SCOUR 行动期间仅少量投入战场。后来，球体共和国颁布堡垒协议后，改型被皇家空军（RAF）采用。其内合金骨架由 17 吨标准装甲保护，使巫妖即使承受大量损伤也能继续作战。

column1: Looking longingly at the sleek and modern fusion engines, but stuck with combustion engine budget? Try the next best thing from Quicsell today. Our XL Internal Combustion Engine is almost as light as one of those fancier engines, and it runs on petrochems!
column2: 想要时髦现代的聚变引擎，却受限于内燃机预算？来试试 Quicsell 今日推出的次优选择吧。我们的 XL 内燃机几乎与那些高档引擎一样轻，而且使用石油化学燃料！

column1: Developed by the Principality of Regulus during the Jihad, the Grand Titan Vengeance trades the weaponry and armor of the standard version for Hardened Armor, an Armored Compact Gyro, Armored Engine, and Armored Cockpit. The 'Mech also has a Full-Head Ejection System. All this protection, and a 60-meter jump radius, seems strange, but the Vengeance has a single Thumper Artillery Piece with two tons of ammo in a CASE II protected bin. This, along with two Clan built ER Medium Lasers, are the only weapons on the unit. This would seem a ridiculously light amount of weaponry, but intelligence reports suggest that the Vengeance uses the Thumper to launch nuclear warheads. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 圣雷吉斯公国在圣战期间开发了大泰坦“复仇者”。它用硬化装甲、装甲紧凑型陀螺仪、装甲引擎和装甲驾驶舱替代标准型号的武器与装甲。该机甲还配备全头弹射系统。如此全面的防护加上 60 米跳跃半径看似有些奇怪，但“复仇者”仅装有一门 Thumper 火炮，并在 CASE II 防护的弹舱中携带两吨弹药。此外，它还装有两门氏族制造的增程中型激光器，这就是该单位的全部武器。武器数量少得离谱，但情报报告称，“复仇者”使用 Thumper 发射核弹头。 特性：多目标追踪 部署费用倍率：1.18

Still in irregular production, the Vulture can be found in any number of variants across most of known space. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Utilizing special adaptations of the chassis the weapon is mounted to allows pushing it beyond original design specifications, resulting in a more variable but most often increased damage. column1: Built by the same company that made the Saracen and Scimitar, the Saladin was Scarborough's last medium hover tank. It is unlike its brothers in that the Saladin does not mount a turret, and its only weapon is a heavy, short-range AC/20. Since it's vastly different from the company's other hovercraft, buyers were quite skeptical about purchasing it; Scarborough had to offer incentives like free training and transportation. Soon it became as cheap as the Saracen and spread throughout the whole Inner Sphere.
column2: 萨拉丁由制造 Saracen 和 Scimitar 的同一家公司生产，是斯卡伯勒最后一款中型悬浮坦克。与同系列其他载具不同，萨拉丁没有炮塔，唯一武器是一门重型短程 AC/20。由于它与公司的其他悬浮载具差异很大，买家起初对购买它颇为怀疑；斯卡伯勒只得提供免费培训和运输等优惠。很快，它的价格便降至与 Saracen 相当，并在整个内天体广泛普及。
